concept.material: hand-carved pale hornblende stone and dark patinated gunmetal
concept.internal_detail: nested coaxial planetary gear rings, miniature brass pawls, and leaf-spring pivots
concept.button: a domed matte black steel stud seated in an off-centre counterbore
concept.button_short: the domed matte black steel stud
concept.shell_mechanic: The fluted oblate disc splits into five radial wedges that hinge outward five degrees from its central vertical axis
concept.emerging_parts: Thirty slender jointed brass spine needles and a central five-jawed miniature Aristotle's lantern armature
concept.signature_move: its radiating needle spines twitch three degrees outward in unison, and its bottom five-jawed brass lantern fixture ratchets closed with a soft metallic click
concept.turkish: Deniz kestanesi (dikenli yuvarlak deniz canlısı) — yivli yassı yuvarlak gövde, soluk hornblend taşı ve patineli tunç

concept.material: polished grey slate and brushed nickel
concept.internal_detail: tiny steel rack-and-pinion gears and silver pushrods
concept.button: a small square nickel stud countersunk flush with the slate
concept.shell_mechanic: The canted slate plates slide apart along diagonal tracks
concept.emerging_parts: Two slender folding wings, a tapered head with a needle beak, and two jointed wire feet
concept.signature_move: its tiny slate head tilts sharply to the side on its ball joint, and its needle beak plates part with a faint metallic tick
concept.turkish: Sığırcık kuşu (küçük ötücü kuş) — eğik kenarlı üçgen takoz, cilalı gri arduvaz taşı ve fırçalanmış nikel
